style: 16-bit pixel art game art, crisp hard-edged pixels, limited night palette: plum black, deep plum, violet glow, cream, sunset orange, warm orange and gold window lights, the career accent colour only on screens and small glows. Dusk City at night: a skyline made of lit window dots, a few still stars
suffix: no people, no faces, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no sunburst rays, no perspective floor grid, no scanlines, no grain, no glowing particles

assets.prompt: the night city under a soft orange dust haze that blurs the lit skyline, in the middle a small air quality sensor box mounted on a pole beside a school gate, its tiny screen glowing with only a periwinkle and orange bar gauge made of coloured bars and no digits, a round warning light on top of the box glowing orange, the school building behind with a few lit windows

a desk at night, in the middle a large monitor showing a spreadsheet grid of blank cells in periwinkle blue-violet, the cells filled with short blank bars and no digits, several rows highlighted orange where cells are empty or broken, one row marked with a small red flag, a magnifying glass resting on the desk in front, a small air quality sensor box beside the monitor, a few sticky notes on the monitor edge, a window onto the hazy night city

a school canteen table at night, in the middle an open orange portfolio binder with a simple periwinkle bar chart pinned inside, a clipboard survey made only of empty tick boxes and blank grey bars beside it, a stack of empty steel canteen food trays, a small university gate on a far hill seen through the canteen window

a desk at night, in the middle a laptop showing one simple periwinkle line chart that rises and falls, one high point circled in orange, no axis labels, an open notebook with blank pages and a pencil beside the laptop, a warm desk lamp, a window onto the night city under a soft orange haze, a small orange flag planted beside the laptop

a rooftop at the edge of the city just before sunrise, a thin orange band of first light on the horizon, in the middle a row of glowing periwinkle blocks rising like a bar chart, forming steps that lead off the roof toward the first light, a small orange flag on the tallest block, a small air quality sensor box on the roof edge
a vertical top-down game world map at night: five small dark islands in a deep plum sea, tiny lit windows on each island, no path, no labels
a chunky pixel picture frame, green outer border, orange corner studs, deep plum dithered interior with a few stars, empty centre
the PassionSeed flame logo as a pixel game host: yellow flame body, black face, big white eyes, holding a small mic, transparent background
the same flame host, mouth open mid-sentence, transparent background
the same flame host winking, transparent background
